verdict.rationale: Medusa is a headless commerce platform where the storefront is a Next.js/Gatsby starter template requiring developer code to build and customize; there is no evidence of a no-code theme marketplace, drag-and-drop layout/section editor, or point-and-click branding tool. Community commentary explicitly confirms this: 'to be a Shopify alternative, headless is not the way... headless makes me think I have to write my own interfaces' — the opposite of the no-code story.
